newsitem.title: USA: Public Storage holders approve plan.
newsitem.headline: Public Storage holders approve plan.

text.p: Public Storage Inc said Friday its shareholder had approved its plan of reorganization.

Under separate plans, Public Storage is to merge with Public Storage Properties XVII Inc, Public Storage Properties XVIII Inc, Public Storage Properties XVI Inc, and Public Storage Properties XIX Inc.
The mergers are expected to be completed June 24.

-- shareholders of Public Storage Properties XVII will receive $0.71 cash per share to ensure compliance with REIT distribution requirements for its final taxable year. In addition, $18.92 a share will be payable in PSA common stock or cash;
-- shareholders of Public Storage Properties XVIII will receive $0.84 cash per share to ensure compliance with REIT distribution requirements, plus $19.55 per share in stock or cash;
-- shareholders of Public Storage Properties XVI will receive $0.75 cash per share to ensure compliance with REIT distribution requirements, plus $20.01 per share in stock or cash;
-- shareholders of Public Storage Properties XIX will receive $0.38 cash per share to ensure compliance with REIT distribution requirements, plus $16.52 per share in stock or cash.
The average closing price of PSA common stock during the specified 20-day valuation period was $27.113.
